items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Blanton's the only thing I had heard... I would have been playing...influenced under what I heard him play. He was really my idol

ctx.x: Had you ever heard him before?
I never heard Jimmy Blanton, never heard his music until Joe Klute, this friend up the street, came down and brought these Jimmy Blanton records.
Were they the ones with Duke...
